categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label and touches wallet database loading in src/wallet/walletdb.cpp and tests in src/wallet/test/walletload_tests.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents an assertion abort when loading a wallet file containing invalid cached xpubs. Rather than deserializing into empty keys and causing CPubKey::Derive to abort the process, the wallet now cleanly detects and reports corruption as DBErrors::CORRUPT at load time.
